title: Combination Sum II
summary: List each distinct combination of input entries whose sum is target.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100 integers in [1, 50]. Target is in [1, 30]. Order is free within combinations and in the outer result.
contractDetails.output-checking: Require every distinct answer once. The outer order and element order within each answer are free.

statement: List each distinct combination of input entries whose sum is target. Each input position can be used once. Equal values at different positions may both be chosen. Two combinations with the same value multiplicities count as one.

examples.explanation: Either both twos or just one two can be used.
All choices of two positions give the same answer.
No input entry can be selected without exceeding the target.

constraints: 1–100 integers in [1, 50]. Target is in [1, 30]. Order is free within combinations and in the outer result.
hints: Conceptual: Equal values can occur in one answer without creating several copies of that answer.
Directional: Sort the input so equal candidates are adjacent.
Implementation: Skip equal choices at the same recursion depth and advance beyond the chosen index before recursing.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log n + n·2ⁿ) worst-case upper bound for sorting and enumeration. O(n) auxiliary space excluding output.
